title: Honey for the Market

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: The honey jars are sealed and labelled. Now they go to market in Bellhaven, packed in crates.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: Four jars in each crate, so they don't rattle. Will you pack them?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put four jars of honey in each crate. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a crate with an empty dip, and put a jar there.

older.prompt: Eight jars in each crate: three crates. No dips to help: count carefully.

feedback.full: That crate is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four crates of four: sixteen jars of honey for the market!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Sixteen jars. Some will be sold, and some given to the poor. Honey tastes sweetest when it's shared.

journal_line: I packed honey into crates for market at the monastery.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Three crates of eight: twenty-four jars! You count like a monk.
